summary: [Digital Morocco 2030](2024-09-25-morocco-strategie-digital-morocco-2030-lancement) is the standing strategy, launched by the ministry in September 2024.
developments:
The ministry's [own launch page](2024-09-25-morocco-strategie-digital-morocco-2030-lancement) is the primary record of the strategy the ledger carries, and no successor or revision has been published.

What has moved under it is delivery rather than doctrine: a [simplification drive that has digitised more than 2,700 procedures and cut paperwork by 45 per cent in pilot zones](2024-02-28-mtnra-simplification-digitalisation-parcours-usagers), and the [interoperability platform recorded live in August 2025 with its binding legal framework still pending](2025-09-17-morocco-world-bank-ennajaa-isr-interoperability).

summary: Data governance rests on the [2009 protection law](2009-02-18-morocco-loi-09-08-protection-donnees-personnelles) and the regulator's deliberations, not on a policy instrument.
developments:
The [2009 law](2009-02-18-morocco-loi-09-08-protection-donnees-personnelles) creates the protection commission and remains the founding statute. The commission governs by deliberation rather than by published policy: it [issued five deliberations in November 2025 on cookies, newsletters, patient tracking and access-control data](2025-11-28-morocco-cndp-nouvelles-deliberations).

The governance layer that would sit above them is not published. The [interoperability platform is live and its binding legal framework is still pending](2025-09-17-morocco-world-bank-ennajaa-isr-interoperability).

summary: [Law 103-12](2014-12-24-morocco-loi-103-12-etablissements-credit) defines electronic money, payment accounts and non-bank payment institutions under central bank approval.
developments:
The [banking law of 2014](2014-12-24-morocco-loi-103-12-etablissements-credit) is the statutory basis for Moroccan payment institutions, and no amending statute appears in the base.

What governs conduct is made under it rather than beside it: the [interchange cap cut to 0.50 per cent from 1 October 2026](2026-07-10-morocco-communique-conjoint-interchange-cap) by the central bank and the competition authority, and the [consolidated forex rulebook in force from 1 January 2026](2025-12-31-morocco-igoc-2026-publication).

summary: The [2026 forex rulebook](2025-12-31-office-des-changes-igoc-2026-release) raises the electronic commerce allowance for accredited start-ups to MAD 2m.
developments:
Electronic dealing rests on the [trust services law of 2020](2020-12-31-morocco-loi-43-20-services-confiance-transactions-electroniques), which governs signatures and certification providers and replaced parts of the earlier electronic exchange law.

The constraint that actually binds cross-border sellers is exchange control, and it loosened: the [2026 general instruction raises the electronic commerce allowance for accredited start-ups to MAD 2m and the individual ceiling to MAD 20,000](2025-12-31-office-des-changes-igoc-2026-release), inside a [256-article consolidated rulebook in force from 1 January](2025-12-31-morocco-igoc-2026-instruction-generale-texte).

summary: [Law 046.26](2026-07-13-morocco-chambre-conseillers-adoption-loi-046-26-047-26) creates a national statistical information council, replacing a governing decree of 1968.
developments:
The system had been governed by a [1968 royal decree creating a statistics coordination committee](1968-08-05-morocco-decret-royal-370-67-etudes-statistiques), which remained the operative law for fifty-eight years.

The replacement moved quickly: [approved by the government council on 2 July 2026](2026-07-02-conseil-gouvernement-approuve-loi-systeme-statistique-national), [adopted unanimously by the second chamber on 13 July](2026-07-13-morocco-chambre-conseillers-adoption-loi-046-26-047-26) with the companion law reforming the planning commission, and [promulgated on 28 July as a 51-article statute splitting the statistical and evaluation functions](2026-07-28-morocco-loi-047-26-haut-commissariat-au-plan).

summary: The [1989 Maghreb Union treaty](1989-02-17-uma-treaty-instituting-arab-maghreb-union) is in force with a binding judicial organ and no summit since 1994.
developments:
The [treaty concluded at Marrakesh in 1989](1989-02-17-uma-treaty-instituting-arab-maghreb-union) supplies a legal frame for regional harmonisation and a judicial organ whose rulings bind, and no summit has been held since 1994.

Harmonisation therefore happens elsewhere: through data-protection accession instruments the ledger carries, and through [continental cross-border data exchange pilots](2025-09-26-morocco-undp-d4sd-launch) — a US$38m hub launched with the development programme in September 2025 to steer artificial intelligence and digital public infrastructure uptake across Arab states and Africa.

summary: The [interoperability platform is live](2025-09-17-morocco-world-bank-ennajaa-isr-interoperability) and its binding legal framework is still pending.
developments:
The [implementation report of August 2025](2025-09-17-morocco-world-bank-ennajaa-isr-interoperability) records the platform in service and the framework that would oblige systems to use it not yet in force — capability without compulsion.

The standards beside it are being set: a [national data classification guide](2025-11-28-morocco-cndp-nouvelles-deliberations) on the ledger and the protection commission's deliberations on specific processing categories.

summary: The two exchanges carry [210 Gbps](2026-01-01-morocco-fezix-ixp-tracker) and [30 Gbps](2026-05-01-morocco-cas-ix-ixp-tracker) across three members each, with net contraction over twelve months.
developments:
A [turnkey contract to build a national internet exchange point](2023-12-21-morocco-anrt-mise-en-place-ixp) was documented by the regulator in December 2023.

What the trackers show is small and shrinking: the [larger exchange at 210 Gbps across three members](2026-01-01-morocco-fezix-ixp-tracker) and the [Casablanca exchange at 30 Gbps across three, with net contraction over the trailing twelve months](2026-05-01-morocco-cas-ix-ixp-tracker). Three members is not a peering fabric for a market this size.

summary: Two institutions tendered recovery platforms in 2026: [108TB scalable past 10PB](2026-05-20-morocco-cmr-backup-tender-108tb) and a [MAD 5m tier three site](2026-06-26-morocco-finance-ministry-backup-platform).
developments:
The pension fund [tendered an anti-ransomware backup platform with 108TB of immediate capacity scalable beyond 10PB](2026-05-20-morocco-cmr-backup-tender-108tb) in May 2026, and the finance ministry [tendered a MAD 5m tier three disaster-recovery platform sited more than 100km from the capital](2026-06-26-morocco-finance-ministry-backup-platform) in June.

Both are procurements rather than facilities in service, and both are institution-specific: no whole-of-government recovery arrangement appears in the base.

summary: The regulator [approved the grid's 2026-2030 renewable hosting capacity](2026-01-30-morocco-anre-capacite-accueil-2026-2030) in January 2026.
developments:
Reliability is measured against indicators the regulator [approved in 2024 and made binding on the transmission operator to report](2024-07-02-morocco-anre-decision-03-24-indicateurs-qualite-reseau).

Capacity planning followed: the regulator [approved and published the national system's renewable hosting capacity for 2026-2030](2026-01-30-morocco-anre-capacite-accueil-2026-2030) in January 2026, and a lender [approved US$265m for a 300MW pumped-hydro storage project](2026-07-01-worldbank-morocco-ifahsa-pumped-hydro) in July. Storage is what makes a renewable-heavy grid reliable for a data centre.

summary: Rural coverage stands at [99.90 per cent at the end of 2024](2026-04-28-morocco-onee-electrification-rurale-perg), effectively complete.
developments:
The utility records [rural electrification at 99.90 per cent by the end of 2024 after 198 further villages were connected](2026-04-28-morocco-onee-electrification-rurale-perg), and the development bank's programme index puts [937 villages electrified against 99.91 per cent national rural coverage](2026-03-06-afdb-morocco-pdrte-er-eer-octobre-2025).

The work now is grid quality rather than reach: [grid, storage and electrification investment continuing toward full coverage](2026-06-05-afdb-morocco-trajectoire-energetique).

summary: The security authority opened [ten state cybersecurity engineer posts](2026-03-01-morocco-dgssi-recrutement-ingenieurs-cybersecurite) in March 2026; no workforce plan is published.
developments:
The diagnostic that still frames this is the [2018 review finding government information technology siloed by ministry with thin local capacity to run systems](2018-07-01-oecd-revue-gouvernement-numerique-maroc).

Against it, recruitment is post by post: [a competition for ten state cybersecurity engineer posts opened in March 2026 and closed that April](2026-03-01-morocco-dgssi-recrutement-ingenieurs-cybersecurite). The authority's own [register of regulated providers lists audit and incident-response firms and no qualified cloud provider](2026-09-03-morocco-dgssi-prestations-produits-reglementes), so the supplier market it would draw on is itself incomplete.

summary: [Article 42 of the 2019 framework law](2019-08-09-maroc-loi-cadre-51-17-education-formation-recherche-scientifique) mandates an integrated education and research information system; none is recorded built.
developments:
The [framework law of 2019](2019-08-09-maroc-loi-cadre-51-17-education-formation-recherche-scientifique) requires a national integrated education, training and research information system. Seven years on nothing in the base records it in service.

The programme that would carry it sets a different kind of target: [55,000 digitally skilled graduates by 2029](2023-11-21-morocco-world-bank-accelerating-transformation-higher-education-pad). The one recorded education data flow is an output rather than an exchange: [2026 examination results delivered by text message with certificates digitised from 18 June](2026-06-17-maroc-men-resultats-bac-juin-2026).

summary: [Law 36.21](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) creates a birth-linked identifier, and its [implementing decree](2023-07-06-portail-collectivites-territoriales-publication-decret-2-22-04-etat-civil) operationalised the platform.
developments:
The [2021 law](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) creates a national digital civil-status register and an identifier attached at birth, and the [2023 implementing decree](2023-07-06-portail-collectivites-territoriales-publication-decret-2-22-04-etat-civil) put the platform into operation.

The legacy stock is what remains: the interior ministry [gave ten regional governors three weeks in October 2025 to digitise paper civil-status registers](2025-10-27-hespress-interieur-walis-numerisation-etat-civil), a deadline the minister [restated in the same month](2025-10-28-hnews-wazir-dakhiliya-rakmanat-halat-madaniya).

summary: The birth-linked identifier created by [law 36.21](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) is the join between registration and the identity credential.
developments:
The [law](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) assigns its identifier at birth, which makes the civil register rather than the identity card the root of Moroccan identity.

The systems on top are being connected in the same period — the [electronic identity card and the national digital wallet tied to it](2026-02-10-morocco-idarati-x0-portefeuille-numerique-national), launched with the protection commission and the security directorate in February 2026 — and the base does not yet record a live link between the register and either.

summary: The fund attributes a [tax take of 24.6 per cent of output in 2025](2026-03-05-imf-morocco-article-iv-2026-report) to the full digitalisation of collection.
developments:
Customs went first: the administration [digitised revenue collection and banned cash for commercial clearance from 2019](2018-01-01-adii-facilitation-dematerialisation-douanes).

The fund's [2026 consultation](2026-03-05-imf-morocco-article-iv-2026-report) puts the result at a tax take of 24.6 per cent of national output in 2025, attributed to full digitalisation of collection — the clearest fiscal return on a digital system the base holds for any unit. The tax directorate's [own procedure page](2026-09-03-dgi-autres-demandes-immatriculation-identifiant-fiscal) shows two online routes to a tax identifier.

summary: The bill settlement rail [opened to fintechs and invoicing software vendors by interface](2026-02-18-cmi-fatourati-agregateur-fintechs-editeurs) in February 2026.
developments:
The platform carried [218m transactions in 2024 and offered a plug-and-play collection add-on requiring no interface work](2025-09-08-cmi-fatourati-collect-reglement-multicanal), which is the low end of the market.

In February 2026 the operator [opened the rail to fintechs and invoicing software vendors through an interface, on a cumulative 240m transactions and MAD 220bn since 2013](2026-02-18-cmi-fatourati-agregateur-fintechs-editeurs). On the public side, suppliers to state enterprises [file invoices and track payment delays electronically](2018-09-18-mef-observatoire-delais-paiement-ajal).

summary: The central bank [acceded to the continental settlement system on 7 July 2025](2025-07-07-papss-bank-al-maghrib-adhesion-17eme-pays-membre) as its seventeenth member country.
developments:
[Accession](2025-07-07-papss-bank-al-maghrib-adhesion-17eme-pays-membre) puts Morocco on the continental rail, and a [global payment network launched real-time payouts in local currency](2025-09-09-thunes-launches-real-time-payments-morocco) two months later against a remittance market of US$11.5bn in 2023.

Exchange control remains the binding rule, and it eased: the [2026 general instruction raised the electronic commerce allowance for accredited start-ups to MAD 2m and the individual ceiling to MAD 20,000](2025-12-31-office-des-changes-igoc-2026-release).

summary: The card [interchange cap was cut to 0.50 per cent](2026-07-10-morocco-communique-conjoint-interchange-cap) from 1 October 2026.
developments:
Protection here is competition remedy rather than complaint procedure. The competition authority [extended the card processor's acquiring divestiture to January and April 2026](2025-10-31-morocco-communique-cmi-desengagement), and the central bank and the authority together [cut the interchange cap to 0.50 per cent with effect from 1 October 2026](2026-07-10-morocco-communique-conjoint-interchange-cap).

Both act on merchant cost rather than on cardholder redress, and no payment complaints route appears in the base.

summary: The digital register created by [law 36.21](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) is operational; [ten governors were given three weeks](2025-10-27-hespress-interieur-walis-numerisation-etat-civil) to digitise paper stock.
developments:
The [law](2021-09-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-loi-36-21-etat-civil) creates the national digital civil-status register and the birth-linked identifier, and the [implementing decree of July 2023](2023-07-06-portail-collectivites-territoriales-publication-decret-2-22-04-etat-civil) put the platform into operation.

Catching up on paper is the live task: [ten regional governors were given three weeks in October 2025](2025-10-27-hespress-interieur-walis-numerisation-etat-civil), and a [further bill adopted unanimously in December 2025 lets the civil-status commission sit without its president to clear the name-change backlog](2025-12-10-lematin-projet-loi-16-25-etat-civil-adopte-conseillers). The municipal programme records the [registry system live in 59 of 97 municipalities](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147).

summary: From [9 December 2025 the identity card address is the sole legal domicile](2025-11-05-lebrief-adresse-cin-domicile-legal) for judicial notices.
developments:
Addressing is a communal competence under a [2017 decree and organic law 113-14](2017-07-03-portail-collectivites-territoriales-la-commune-decret-2-17-307-adressage), which sets the system but not its legal weight.

That changed: [from 9 December 2025 the address on the national identity card became the sole legal domicile for judicial notices, ending the proxy arrangement that preceded it](2025-11-05-lebrief-adresse-cin-domicile-legal). An address on a credential now carries legal consequence, which is a stronger position than a register alone.

summary: [109,644 enterprises on the register in 2025, up 14.6 per cent](2026-02-24-ompic-bilan-2025-dynamique-entrepreneuriale), with 42,905 new registrations to May 2026.
developments:
The register was founded by the [1996 commercial code and given electronic filing by law 88-17](1996-08-01-ministere-justice-code-commerce-registre).

Its throughput is published and rising: [109,644 enterprises in 2025, up 14.6 per cent, with the country climbing to 57th in the global innovation index](2026-02-24-ompic-bilan-2025-dynamique-entrepreneuriale), and [42,905 new registrations in the first five months of 2026 with legal persons rising to 75 per cent of the total](2026-07-21-ompic-42900-immatriculations-fin-mai-2026).

summary: The tax directorate publishes [two online routes to a tax identifier](2026-09-03-dgi-autres-demandes-immatriculation-identifiant-fiscal), against a [24.6 per cent tax take](2026-03-05-imf-morocco-article-iv-2026-report).
developments:
The [directorate's live procedure page](2026-09-03-dgi-autres-demandes-immatriculation-identifiant-fiscal) shows two online routes to obtaining a Moroccan tax identifier, which is registration as a service rather than a counter visit.

What the register produces is measured: the fund attributes a [tax take of 24.6 per cent of output in 2025 to the full digitalisation of collection](2026-03-05-imf-morocco-article-iv-2026-report). The directorate is also [piloting artificial-intelligence property valuation in two cities](2026-02-20-lodj-dgi-controle-fiscal-immobilier-ia), which uses the register rather than extending it.

summary: The [integrated education information system mandated in 2019](2019-08-09-maroc-loi-cadre-51-17-education-formation-recherche-scientifique) is not recorded built.
developments:
Article 42 of the [2019 framework law](2019-08-09-maroc-loi-cadre-51-17-education-formation-recherche-scientifique) requires a national integrated education, training and research information system, and nothing in the base records it operating.

The sector's digital output is examination administration rather than management: [262,442 candidates passed the 2026 school-leaving examination with results by text message and certificates digitised from 18 June](2026-06-17-maroc-men-resultats-bac-juin-2026).

summary: [22.5m enrolled in the population registry and 5.3m families in the unified social registry](2025-09-17-marocma-generalisation-protection-sociale-rnp-rsu), with coverage tripling to 24.3m since 2021.
developments:
The [government's own account of September 2025](2025-09-17-marocma-generalisation-protection-sociale-rnp-rsu) puts the population registry at 22.5m enrolled and the unified social registry at 5.3m families, with medical coverage tripling to 24.3m people since 2021.

Two qualifications follow. The [audit court urged in February 2026 that the population registry agency be activated](2026-02-03-maroc-cour-des-comptes-expose-premier-president-parlement), so the body governing the register is not yet standing; and the delivery agency [opened its first territorial office in the same month](2026-02-27-anss-premiere-representation-territoriale-el-jadida), moving beyond a purely digital channel.

summary: The ministry [launched a platform publishing in-absentia case data](2026-03-12-maroc-justice-plateforme-mastara-ghiyabiya) in March 2026 and [joined the information portal](2026-03-31-maroc-justice-adhesion-pndai) that month.
developments:
Court digitisation was appraised in [2012, covering electronic filing and case management](2012-05-16-morocco-world-bank-judicial-performance-enhancement-service-citizen-pad).

What the window adds is publication rather than process: a [platform publishing in-absentia defendants' case data, searchable on the courts portal](2026-03-12-maroc-justice-plateforme-mastara-ghiyabiya), and the ministry [signing accession to the national right-to-information portal on 31 March 2026](2026-03-31-maroc-justice-adhesion-pndai).

summary: [436,000 land titles registered in 2025 across 1.05m hectares](2026-06-30-le360-ancfcc-performance-historique-2025-comptes), up 17 per cent.
developments:
Electronic case management for land registration is governed by [decree 2-18-181](2018-12-10-maroc-ancfcc-textes-juridiques-decret-gestion-electronique-immatriculation-fonciere), which is the instrument behind the throughput.

The agency's [2025 board recorded DH 10.9bn of turnover and 430,000 titles issued, up 15 per cent](2025-12-19-aujourdhui-ancfcc-conseil-administration-2025), and its [accounts put the final figure at 436,000 titles across 1.05m hectares with DH 7.5bn returned to the state and further cybersecurity investment](2026-06-30-le360-ancfcc-performance-historique-2025-comptes).

summary: The permit platform is [live in all municipalities covering 16.9m people](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147).
developments:
The [2021 strategy](2021-01-01-maroc-dgct-strategie-transformation-digitale-collectivites-territoriales) named four platforms for local government — permits, complaints, transparency and certificates — as the programme.

The [implementation report of March 2026](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147) records the permit platform live in every municipality covering 16.9m people, and the civil registry system in 59 of 97. Regions are now building their own back offices: one [tendered a MAD 35m integrated records system for human resources, budget and archives](2026-07-17-medias24-casablanca-settat-systeme-information-integre) in July 2026.

summary: The civil registry system is [live in 59 of 97 municipalities](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147); a region tendered a [MAD 35m records system](2026-07-17-medias24-casablanca-settat-systeme-information-integre).
developments:
Municipal records are the slower half of the local programme: [59 of 97 municipalities on the civil registry system](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147) against the permit platform's full coverage.

The paper stock behind them is what the interior ministry is chasing, having [given ten regional governors three weeks in October 2025 to digitise civil-status registers](2025-10-27-hespress-interieur-walis-numerisation-etat-civil). One region has moved to its own back office, [tendering a MAD 35m system for human resources, budget and archives with bids due in September 2026](2026-07-17-medias24-casablanca-settat-systeme-information-integre).

summary: [1,400 primary health facilities were rehabilitated](2026-04-06-marocma-achevement-1400-etablissements-sante-primaires) with the digital information system generalised across them.
developments:
The [health framework law of 2022](2022-12-09-maroc-loi-cadre-06-22-systeme-national-sante) creates a national integrated health information system and a shared patient record, which is the architecture the facilities connect to.

The estate was rebuilt to receive it: [1,400 primary health facilities rehabilitated at MAD 6.43bn with the digital information system generalised](2026-04-06-marocma-achevement-1400-etablissements-sante-primaires). Diagnostic tooling followed into two rural clinics: [artificial-intelligence ultrasound, with breast-cancer screening deployed in the capital](2026-06-02-marocma-hopitaux-publics-ia-diagnostic-precoce).

summary: A consortium is extending connected classrooms to [40 more schools against a 30,000-pupil target](2026-02-23-lematin-classes-connectees-dir-iddik-benevolat) for 2026.
developments:
The national programme has covered rural schools since its inception: the regulator's [initiative brings ICT infrastructure, training and resources to every school including rural ones](2013-01-01-maroc-anrt-programme-genie-tice), with [87 per cent of staff trained and coding pilots from 2016](2018-09-20-unesco-evolution-programme-genie-maroc-prix).

Operator-led work is extending it: a consortium [expanding connected classrooms to 40 further schools against a 30,000-pupil target for 2026, with a national call for volunteers](2026-02-23-lematin-classes-connectees-dir-iddik-benevolat).

summary: No station-level system is described; police digital provision is [online services and reporting portals](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147) rather than station records.
developments:
Nothing in the base records digital case records or connectivity at Moroccan police stations outside the cities.

What the ledger carries is citizen-facing: police online services and reporting portals. The rural service presence that has moved is registration rather than policing — [mobile identity enrolment units and registry extension to rural and remote areas](2026-03-09-worldbank-isr-municipal-performance-program-p168147), both already on the ledger.

summary: The tax directorate is [piloting artificial-intelligence property valuation](2026-02-20-lodj-dgi-controle-fiscal-immobilier-ia) in two cities, replacing auditor discretion.
developments:
Three deployments are on the record and each sits inside an existing system rather than beside it. The tax directorate is [piloting artificial-intelligence property valuation with a private partner in Rabat and Casablanca, replacing auditor discretion](2026-02-20-lodj-dgi-controle-fiscal-immobilier-ia); the health ministry has [deployed artificial-intelligence ultrasound in two rural clinics and breast-cancer screening in the capital](2026-06-02-marocma-hopitaux-publics-ia-diagnostic-precoce).

The governing arrangement is being built alongside: a [ministry and protection commission pact for a sovereign Moroccan-language model platform for citizens and administrations](2025-09-11-morocco-convention-cadre-ia-responsable-cndp-mtnra), and the minister's [presentation of the government artificial-intelligence project and a research institute to Parliament in June 2026](2026-06-08-maroc-mtnra-expose-commission-justice-idaratiia).

summary: A renewed vendor partnership [certified 261 teachers in artificial intelligence and programming](2026-02-03-marocma-avenant-samsung-innovation-campus) during 2025.
developments:
The base rate is the national programme: [ICT infrastructure, training and resources to every school](2013-01-01-maroc-anrt-programme-genie-tice), with [87 per cent of staff trained and coding pilots running since 2016](2018-09-20-unesco-evolution-programme-genie-maroc-prix).

On top of it, a [partnership renewed in February 2026 certified 261 teachers in artificial intelligence and programming during 2025](2026-02-03-marocma-avenant-samsung-innovation-campus), and [second-year robotics workshops reached 120 students at one site with ministry-supplied equipment](2025-10-18-aljisr-ptech-ksar-sghir-robotique).

summary: The first paid work-study data and artificial intelligence master's [opened with 30 students across four corporate hosts](2025-10-06-fondationalmada-master-data-ia-inpt).
developments:
The target is set: [55,000 digitally skilled graduates by 2029](2023-11-21-morocco-world-bank-accelerating-transformation-higher-education-pad) under the higher education programme.

The route being built toward it runs through industry: the country's [first paid work-study data and artificial intelligence master's opened in October 2025 with 30 students and four corporate hosts](2025-10-06-fondationalmada-master-data-ia-inpt). No series counts graduates entering digital employment, so the target has no published progress measure against it.

summary: The census analysis counts [1.73m disabled Moroccans, 67.7 per cent with no schooling](2026-03-24-personnes-situation-handicap-maroc-rgph-2024).
developments:
The [analysis of the 2024 census published in March 2026](2026-03-24-personnes-situation-handicap-maroc-rgph-2024) is the country's current disability baseline: 1.73m people, and 67.7 per cent of them with no schooling — an education gap that precedes any question of digital access.

Measurement is being deepened with a [third national disability survey launched in January 2026](2026-01-21-hcp-lancement-troisieme-enquete-handicap), and the one concrete access measure in the window is transport: a [permanent 50 per cent rail fare reduction for disability card holders and their guides](2025-12-02-oncf-carte-50-pourcent-personnes-handicapees).

summary: [18,900 refugees registered at the end of 2024](2026-01-29-unhcr-morocco-country-page); no digital service route for them is described.
developments:
The refugee agency records [18,900 refugees registered at the end of 2024](2026-01-29-unhcr-morocco-country-page), and the census counted [148,152 foreign residents, up 76 per cent since 2014](2025-11-01-hcp-residents-etrangers-au-maroc).

Neither source describes how either population reaches Moroccan digital services. The identity credential that carries service access is a national one, and no equivalent for non-nationals appears in the base.

summary: A [51-article statute promulgated on 28 July 2026](2026-07-28-morocco-loi-047-26-haut-commissariat-au-plan) remakes the planning commission as an autonomous good-governance body.
developments:
The reform was announced before it was legislated: the commission's head [set out a peer-reviewed overhaul of official statistics, a 2026 employment survey reform and administrative data agreements](2025-10-21-hcp-jms-2025-allocution) in October 2025.

The statute followed, [adopted unanimously by the second chamber in July 2026](2026-07-14-adoption-reforme-hcp-systeme-statistique-national) and [promulgated on 28 July, splitting the statistical and evaluation functions across 51 articles](2026-07-28-morocco-loi-047-26-haut-commissariat-au-plan), alongside the law creating a national statistical information council.

summary: A [redesigned labour force survey](2026-05-04-emo2026-marche-travail-t1-2026) ran for the first quarter of 2026 with the sample raised by half.
developments:
The census fixed the [legal population at 36.83m at 1 September 2024](2024-11-07-population-legale-rgph-2024), which is the frame every survey is drawn against.

The survey programme was then rebuilt: a [redesigned labour force survey aligned to international methodology for the first quarter of 2026 with the sample up 50 per cent](2026-05-04-emo2026-marche-travail-t1-2026), a [third time-use survey covering more than 14,000 households with field collection from 20 April 2026](2026-04-02-hcp-enquete-emploi-du-temps-2026-2027), and a [third disability survey launched in January](2026-01-21-hcp-lancement-troisieme-enquete-handicap).

summary: The commission announced [administrative data agreements](2025-10-21-hcp-jms-2025-allocution) alongside its statistical overhaul in October 2025.
developments:
The statistics directorate has long been [charged with processing administrative and civil-registration statistics](2018-04-06-hcp-direction-de-la-statistique-missions); what it lacked was the agreements to get at the sources.

Those were [announced in October 2025 alongside a peer-reviewed overhaul and the 2026 employment survey reform](2025-10-21-hcp-jms-2025-allocution). The [national statistical information council created in July 2026](2026-07-02-conseil-gouvernement-approuve-loi-systeme-statistique-national) is the body that would govern such flows, and no published series yet rests on them.

summary: The meteorological directorate [hosted a regional satellite data processing workshop](2026-06-29-dgm-eumetsat-atelier-casablanca) with the European satellite organisation in June 2026.
developments:
The service [names weather satellites as essential to its 24-hour observation network alongside radar and ground stations](2018-04-06-marocmeteo-observation-satellites-meteorologiques), so reception and use are long established.

What the window adds is a change of role: the directorate and the [European satellite organisation ran a Casablanca workshop on satellite data processing for operational meteorology across Africa](2026-06-29-dgm-eumetsat-atelier-casablanca), which puts Morocco in the training seat rather than the receiving one.

summary: [Twelve investment memoranda](2023-12-04-uae-morocco-12-mous-exchange-ceremony) span rail, energy, ports and data centres; no data centre has since been recorded proceeding under them.
developments:
The [exchange ceremony of December 2023](2023-12-04-uae-morocco-12-mous-exchange-ceremony) put twelve memoranda on the record covering rail, energy, ports and data centres.

Nothing in the base since names a data centre proceeding under any of them. Where a large facility has moved it has moved on other paper: the [convention signed in April 2026 launching studies for a 500MW green data-centre campus at Dakhla](2026-04-14-mmsp-convention-igoudar-numerique-dakhla), between ministries, the region and state funds.
